description: Againity AB, DBA Againity, is a Swedish private company specialized in the manufacturing and supply of Organic Rankine Cycle (ORC) turbines and Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) for renewable energy applications. Againity also provides energy storage solutions that integrate with ORC systems to support sustainable energy supply and backup power.
